title: Inverse Problems for Partial Differential Equations with Jump Discontinuities in Coefficients via Two-Stage Physics-Informed Deep Learning and Statistical Mixture Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.14656v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This work proposes a two-stage physics-informed deep learning framework that combines neural-network-based sampling with statistical inference and constrained parameter refinement. In the first stage, a dual-network physics-informed architecture is used, where a main network approximates the PDE solution and an auxiliary coefficient sub network provides a relaxed continuous surrogate of the true discontinuous coefficient field. A gradient-adaptive weighting strategy is incorporated into the physics residual to improve residual training and enhance sampling reliability near possible discontinuity regions. The sampled coefficient values are then analyzed using Bayesian learning for Gaussian mixture models and birth-death Markov chain model selection, which estimate the number of coefficient regimes and provide heuristic search intervals for coefficient values and candidate transition regions. translated_title: 系数具有跳跃不连续性的偏微分方程反问题：基于两阶段物理信息深度学习和统计混合模型的方法
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种两阶段物理信息深度学习框架，该框架结合了基于神经网络的采样、统计推断和约束参数细化。在第一阶段，采用双网络物理信息架构，其中主网络近似偏微分方程解，辅助系数子网络提供真实不连续系数场的松弛连续代理。在物理残差中引入梯度自适应加权策略，以改善残差训练并增强可能不连续区域附近的采样可靠性。然后，利用贝叶斯学习对高斯混合模型和生灭马尔可夫链模型选择进行分析采样系数值，这些方法估计系数区域的数量，并为系数值和候选过渡区域提供启发式搜索区间。在第二阶段，反问题被处理。
tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段物理信息深度学习框架，通过双网络架构和统计混合模型，有效解决了系数具有跳跃不连续性的偏微分方程反问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage physics-informed deep learning framework with dual-network architecture and statistical mixture models to effectively solve inverse problems for PDEs with jump discontinuities in coefficients.
